traygen.flagConfig: path to the trayicons CUE config
traygen.flagOut: output directory (default: the config file's directory)
traygen.long: traygen renders a tray icon per theme and state from the labeled SVGs a trayicons.cue names, writes Go accessors for them and draws preview sheets. Run it from go:generate next to the config.
traygen.short: Generate themed tray icons, Go accessors and preview sheets from labeled SVGs
